# Step 3 — Modern Turtle rulebook backtest (generated by scripts/step3_modern.py)

Track B, 14 ETFs, long/flat, trading 2008-01-02 → 2026-11-24. Rulebook defaults; cash account (1x gross cap); 2 bp slippage; T-bill interest. Random benchmark: 100 runs per variant.

## Pre-registered criteria

| criterion | value | pass |
|---|---|---|
| P1 excess Sharpe > 0 | 0.48 | True |
| P2 <= 10% of random entries (with trend filter) beat it | 4% | True |
| P3 excess Sharpe > 0 in >= 7 of 9 grid cells | 9 of 9 | True |
